scope: Primary-source mechanism guidance for the authored two-passage learned retrieval and conditional-token teaching model, plus a contrasting learned reranker reference. Agent review, not human scientific approval.

sources.locator: Sections 3.1–3.2: separate encoders, dot-product similarity, positive/negative passage objective; rendered lines 89–108
sources.supports: A learned query/passage representation can be trained by negative log likelihood of the correct passage against alternatives.
sources.doesNotSupport: The toy mean encoder is not the paper's BERT/FAISS implementation. No retrieval benchmark, broad generalization or corpus-scale result transfers.

sources.locator: Abstract: true previous tokens in training, generated previous tokens in inference and accumulated-error discrepancy; rendered lines 16–18
sources.supports: Distinguishing teacher-forced training inputs from generated-token inputs at inference.
sources.doesNotSupport: The toy decoder has no recurrent hidden state and does not implement scheduled sampling. No paper performance result transfers.

sources.locator: Abstract: parametric generator and retrieved nonparametric context; sequence versus per-token context formulations
sources.supports: Separating learned generation parameters from retrieved reference material used as conditioning information.
sources.doesNotSupport: No paper model, joint marginalization, factuality benchmark or open-domain behavior is reproduced by these two action sentences.

sources.version: Official stable documentation returned 1.9.0 on review date; URL is unpinned
sources.locator: Sections 12.1–12.2, particularly train-only fit/preprocessing and test information leakage; rendered lines 77–124
sources.supports: Fit vocabulary/parameters using training inputs and keep held-out requests out of updates; repeated evaluation-driven choices limit independence.
sources.doesNotSupport: Four fixture paraphrases do not establish real-world generalization, calibration or safety.

sources.locator: Abstract only: query-based passage reranking using BERT; rendered lines 16–17. Architecture sections were not reviewed.
sources.supports: A distinct passage-reranking stage can use a learned model; this source is a contrast to the experience's explicit authored entity-match rule.
sources.doesNotSupport: No BERT, learned cross scorer, paper architecture or benchmark result is implemented or transferred. The literal alias rule and its ambiguity/negation limitations are authored fixture behavior.
